summary: Master Brain analytics timeout fix + preview/confirm action flow verified end-to-end against the external preview URL. 7/7 backend tests pass. Real data returned for KPI, tier distribution, negative-balance audit, and fix-negative — none produced 'Data Unavailable' / 'System Timeout' / 'timed out'. Grant bonus flow works: preview asks for confirmation+reason; confirm applies the 50 pts and returns an audit ID; balance-verify shows Karan Singh (6000013876) with 50 pts.

minor.issue: Transient 'AI usage budget exhausted' response observed briefly during the first run of test_05 (~66s wall time). Auto top-up recovered within ~60s and all tests passed on immediate re-run. Not a code bug — flagged as advised in the review note. Recommend monitoring auto top-up cadence during large analytics bursts.

On the confirm turn (test_06), the model occasionally responds 'I do not currently have a grant_bonus_points tool' — a stale system-prompt hallucination — then applies correctly on the explicit 'confirm=true, reason:' retry. The retry path was defensively coded into the test. E1 may want to make the confirm-tool selection more deterministic (e.g., inject grant_bonus_points into tools_used metadata when the previous turn was a grant PREVIEW in the same session_id).

action_items: Optional: harden confirm-turn tool selection so the model always calls grant_bonus_points(confirm=true) on the second turn of a grant session, without needing a re-prompt.
Optional: keep the LLM key auto top-up healthy — one transient 'budget exhausted' was observed during heavy first-call analytics.
critical_code_review_comments: Timeout fix is effective: heavy aggregations (~800k customers, ~14L transactions) completed in 18-25s wall-clock via `with pymongo.timeout(25)` — well inside the 46s outer wait_for cap.
60s stats cache is working — repeat KPI/tier calls in the same window are noticeably faster.
Negative-balance audit correctly returns 0 field balances AND cross-checks 157 ledger-sum negatives — honest, no fabrication.
Preview→confirm audit trail returns a proper audit UUID (e.g., cb2d7d4b-...) — good.
seed_data_creation: Grant flow granted 50 pts to customer 6000013876 (Karan Singh). Balance moved 0 → 50. Audit ID logged. Reversible via Action Log Undo.
